messages:
Maria H: Quick follow-up on the billing postmortem — we had ~12h of under-reported token counts due to delayed usage ingestion. Need clear owners, timelines, and a plan for invoice corrections.
Samir: I can own the ingestion fix. Root cause looks like overlapping backfill jobs causing a dedup bug in the pipeline. Planning a lock + idempotency change.
Samir: ETA for deploy to staging: tomorrow AM. ETA prod rollback-safe deploy: EOD Thu. Will open a PR and add tests.
Kevin L: I will own customer-facing remediation (credits and comms). Need the final impacted-customer list and corrected totals before drafting messages.
Anna P: I’ll run the impacted customers export once Samir confirms the corrected counts. I can produce CSV + reconciliation report. ETA for initial list: 24h.
FinanceBot: Automated scan attached: 47 accounts flagged with >1% variance; 8 accounts >20% variance. Summary: total potential credit ~$18.2k (pre-approval).
Samir: Quick note — temp mitigation I can enable tonight: pause the second backfill and re-run with dedupe flag. That should limit additional divergence.
Maria H: Add an acceptance criterion: reconciled tokens must match raw ingestion logs for a 7-day sample and be within 0.5% of expected.
Kevin L: For credits > $5k, we need legal approval and exec sign-off. Tagging @Legal for early review.
Legal: Acknowledge. Will review the proposed credit thresholds and customer language. Please send sample email copy once available.
Samir: PR opened: `https://github.com/redwood-inference/ingest/pull/2345` — implements job lock + idempotency. Tests included. Putting a note in the deploy runbook.
Anna P: Uploaded preliminary CSV to /shared/finance/token-recon/1789234567.csv — this is pre-fix numbers. Will update after Samir confirms staging run.
Maria H: Action items recap:
- Samir: deploy fix to staging + run reconciliation (ETA staging tomorrow AM, prod EOD Thu)
- Anna P: generate impacted customers list and final reconciliation (ETA 24h after staging results)
- Kevin L: draft customer comms and credits proposal (pending final numbers)
- Legal: review credit thresholds and comms (ASAP)
- FinanceBot/finance team: prepare invoice correction process template (who signs, timing)
Samir: Will also add a small monitoring alert to catch future delayed ingestion >5m lag and escalate to eng-oncall.
Kevin L: Once final totals are in, I’ll prepare a short summary doc for execs and cc support & account teams.
Maria H: Let's target a short sync tomorrow at 11am to confirm staging results and next steps. If anything slips, update this thread. :thumbsup:
Samir: noted, will post staging logs and reconciliation link here after job runs.
Anna P: will update CSV and ping Kevin when final numbers available.
FinanceBot: Next automated follow-up scheduled in 48h to check if reconciliation artifacts exist.
Maria H: thanks everyone — please add any missing owners here.
